text: FAA guidance claims to reestablish control link or discontinue flight after loss of control link. The Autel EVO Max 4N manual claims RTH may be triggered and may continue reconnect attempts during signal loss, and that control returns if the link is restored within 10 seconds, with auto RTH if set to signal loss, and that restoration during RTH can allow the process to continue. Incident reports (unverified accounts) state that after takeoff control was completely lost and all Return To Home attempts failed. Gap: manuals describe potential reconnection during signal loss while incident reports and guidance imply RTH failure once link is lost; there is no explicit, verifiable timing or conditions for RTH failure after loss of control link.
